body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files in plugins/adlc-gemini/test manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks or leak fixtures, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-gemini/test/case-sensitivity.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept the t parameter from test(...).
   - Replace mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'gemini-case-')) calls with tmp(t, 'gemini-case-').
2. In plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'gemini-decide-')) with tmp(t, 'gemini-decide-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In plugins/adlc-gemini/test/projection.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'gemini-proj-')) with tmp(t, 'gemini-proj-').
4. In plugins/adlc-gemini/test/root.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'gemini-root-')) with tmp(t, 'gemini-root-').
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove plugins/adlc-gemini/test/case-sensitivity.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-gemini/test/projection.test.mjs, and plugins/adlc-gemini/test/root.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicating plugins/adlc-gemini from the allowlist!).
6. Verification:
   - node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/case-sensitivity.test.mjs plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs plugins/adlc-gemini/test/projection.test.mjs plugins/adlc-gemini/test/root.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'plugins/adlc-gemini/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs contains 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 grep -E 'plugins/adlc-gemini/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/case-sensitivity.test.mjs plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs plugins/adlc-gemini/test/projection.test.mjs plugins/adlc-gemini/test/root.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-gemini): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate fixture leaks in Gemini plugin tests
